description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This part is the Windshield Washer Tank HOSE that carries water from the Washer Tank to the Washer Nozzle located on the windshield frame.
Includes everything you need to replace your old hose.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Hose (Includes Rubber Grommet)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
